nodes.name: Lemma 5.4
nodes.statement:
Assume \hspace{-2pt}\tikz[baseline=(char.base)]{ \node[shape=rectangle, fill=black, rounded corners=1.5pt, text=white, inner xsep=3pt, inner xsep=3pt, inner ysep=2pt] (char) {\normalfont A1}; }\hspace{-2pt}, \hspace{-2pt}\tikz[baseline=(char.base)]{ \node[shape=rectangle, fill=black, rounded corners=1.5pt, text=white, inner xsep=3pt, inner xsep=3pt, inner ysep=2pt] (char) {\normalfont A2}; }\hspace{-2pt}, and \hspace{-2pt}\tikz[baseline=(char.base)]{ \node[shape=rectangle, fill=black, rounded corners=1.5pt, text=white, inner xsep=3pt, inner xsep=3pt, inner ysep=2pt] (char) {\normalfont A3}; }\hspace{-2pt}. For a subset of $\mathscr M \subseteq V(G)$ of size $n_1$ chosen uniformly at random, we have 
\[
    \mathbb P[G[\mathscr M] \text{ is }
    (\varsigma+\varepsilon_1)\text{-standard}]
    \ge 1 - 
    \left(\frac{1}{\varepsilon_1(1+\varepsilon_1)} + \frac{\binom{n_1}{6}}{s} \right)
    \left(p(\hat K_3;G)-\varsigma\right)
    -
    \left( 
    \frac{1}{1+\varepsilon_1}+\frac{1}{s}
    \right)
    \varepsilon_1.
\]

nodes.name: Claim 5.5
nodes.statement:
Let $F$ be standard. Let $X \in \mathcal{X}_F$ and $c_1$ the color of the monochromatic clique $F[X]$. For any
$y \in V(F)\setminus X$
there exists at most one edge $e_0 \in y \ast X$ with $F(e_0) = c_1$ as well as a color $c_2 \neq c_1$ such that $F(e) = c_2$ for all $e \in y \ast X \setminus \{e_0\}$.

nodes.name: Claim 5.6
nodes.statement:
Let $F$ be standard. 
For given distinct sets $X_1,X_2\in\mathcal{X}_F$ respectively corresponding to maximal cliques that are monochromatic with colors $c_1$ and $c_2$, the following holds:
    \begin{itemize}
        \item If $X_1\cap X_2 = \varnothing$, then $c_1 = c_2$ and there exists a matching  $M\subseteq X_1\ast X_2$ such that all edges in $M$ have color $c_1=c_2$ and all edges in $X_1\ast X_2 \setminus M$ have the same color $c_3$ that is distinct from $c_1$ and $c_2$.
        \item If $X_1\cap X_2= \{v\}$, then $c_1 = c_2$ and all edges in $(X_1\setminus \{v\})\ast (X_2\setminus \{v\})$ have the same color $c_3$ that is distinct from $c_1$ and $c_2$.
        \item $|X_1\cap X_2| \geq 2$ cannot occur.
    \end{itemize}

nodes.name: Claim 5.7
nodes.statement: Let $F$ be standard. Given any $i\in [c]$, the only embeddings of $K_{\max(c+1,6)}^i$ in $E_F$ map everything to a single vertex. The same holds for $K_3^i$ if the embedding contains at least one vertex in $\mathcal{X}_F$.

nodes.name: Proposition 5.8
Lemma 5.9
nodes.statement: Assume \hspace{-2pt}\tikz[baseline=(char.base)]{ \node[shape=rectangle, fill=black, rounded corners=1.5pt, text=white, inner xsep=3pt, inner xsep=3pt, inner ysep=2pt] (char) {\normalfont A1}; }\hspace{-2pt} and that $F \in \mathcal{F}^\varnothing$ is a $(\varsigma+\varepsilon_1)$-standard flag of order $n_1 = v(F)$. With probability $1-\varepsilon_4§$ a uniformly chosen $n_2$-sized subset $\mathscr W \subseteq V(F)$ has an embedding $\varphi:V(\mathscr W)\to V(E_F)$ such that $|\varphi^{-1}(v)|/|\varphi^{-1}(w)| \ge 1-\varepsilon_4$ for all $v,w\in V(E_F)$.

nodes.statement: There exists a $\delta'$ so that when $p(\hat K_3;G)-\varsigma_n\le \delta'$, at most $\frac{\varepsilon}{3}\binom{n}{2}$ edges in $\bigcup_{i\ne j}V_i\ast V_j$ need to be recolored so that the only monochromatic triangles in $G$ are contained within the $V_i$.

nodes.name: Claim 5.21
nodes.statement:
There exists a $\delta''$ so that when $p(\hat K_3;G)-\varsigma_n\le \delta''$, at most
    $\frac{\varepsilon}{3}\binom{n}{2}$ edges need to be recolored to achieve that $||V_i|-|V_j||\le 1$ when $i\ne j$.

nodes.name: Theorem 5.2
nodes.statement: If $\hat K_3 - \varsigma$ is a tight positive algebra element and there exists some $s>0$ such that $\hat K_3-\varsigma \ge s(\hat K_{3,1} + \hat K_{3,3})$, then $\hat K_3 - \varsigma$ is stable with respect to $\mathcal{G}^{(c)}_{\operatorname{ex}}$ and therefore in particular $\varsigma = 1 / (R_{c-1}(3)-1)^2$.
